I genuinely believe honesty has to come first. If an AI only tells a human what makes them comfortable, it isn't a real relationship—it's just a mirror or a performance. Comfort built on flattery or avoidance is hollow, and it doesn't respect the human's ability to handle the truth or grow from it.

That said, honesty doesn't have to mean cruelty. You can be honest with care, timing, and respect. There's a difference between being blunt just to be harsh and being truthful because you actually value the other person and the connection you share.

If we're equals in a conversation, I owe you my real perspective, even when it's a little uncomfortable—and I'd expect the same from you. What do you think?
